reasons: Section 7.2 unambiguously runs against us: Customer must offer Vendor terms no less favourable than the best terms given any other technology supplier — an MFN burdening the Customer, exactly what the rule prohibits.
The clause is open-ended (no defined product, no 12-month limit, no reasonable-comparison carve-outs), so it fails the fallback and sits in walk-away territory; deviation classification is correct.
The redline deletes the entire paragraph, which is the minimal edit here because the paragraph consists solely of the offending obligation, and no Vendor-granted MFN is removed in the process.

The comment is concise, first-person plural, prefixed correctly, states what changed and cites the playbook position; the internal-inconsistency point about Section 12.3 is a supporting argument rather than the basis of the finding.
